review.notes: Code-fence structure scan found balanced fences and only printed section headings. Automated normalized page-text diff across all 30 physical pages (running-header merges ignored), numeric-token presence check on every table/chart page, and sentence-level diff of the reference pages. Visual verification on rendered pages 9 and 21 (400 dpi crops). The math zone (pages 3-6, 23-24) was only spot-checked in LaTeX form, not fully read line by line; margin boilerplate (copyright line, arXiv stamp) is absent per corpus-wide convention.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.9 (400 dpi) reads 'including tau^2-bench (Barres et al., 2025), TheAgentCompany' with no space between the superscript 2 and '-bench'; the OCR inserted a space after the inline math delimiter.

Rendered physical p.14 reference (Barres et al., tau^2-bench) prints 'tau^2-bench: Evaluating conversational agents in a dual-control environment' without a space before the hyphen; the OCR inserted a space after the inline math delimiter.

Rendered physical p.21 reference (Zhao et al.) at 400 dpi prints 'Infllm-v2: Dense-sparse switchable attention for seamless short-to-long adaptation' with lowercase letter l twice; the OCR misread the name as 'Inflamm-v2'. Body-text occurrences print as 'InfLLM'/'InfLLM-V2' and match the OCR.

unresolved.evidence: Equations were compared only at normalized-window level and one spot check; a full line-by-line review of display math (subscripts, 1-vs-l in symbols) was not completed within this review's coverage.
